requests.name: Get Application Info
requests.description: Retrieve general information about the UniFi Network application.

requests.name: List Local Sites
requests.description: Retrieve a paginated list of local sites managed by this Network application.

requests.name: List Devices Pending Adoption
requests.description: Retrieve a paginated list of devices pending adoption, including basic device information.

requests.name: List Adopted Devices
requests.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all adopted devices on a site, including basic device information.

requests.name: Adopt Devices
requests.description: Adopt a device to a site.

requests.name: Remove (Unadopt) Device
requests.description: Removes (unadopts) an adopted device from the site. If the device is online, it will be reset to factory defaults.

requests.name: Get Adopted Device Details
requests.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific adopted device, including firmware versioning, uplink state, details about device features and interfaces (ports, radios) and other key attributes.

requests.name: Execute Adopted Device Action
requests.description: Perform an action on an specific adopted device. The request body must include the action name and any applicable input arguments.

requests.name: Execute Port Action
requests.description: Perform an action on a specific device port. The request body must include the action name and any applicable input arguments.

requests.name: Get Latest Adopted Device Statistics
requests.description: Retrieve the latest real-time statistics of a specific adopted device, such as uptime, data transmission rates, CPU and memory utilization.

requests.name: List Connected Clients
requests.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all connected clients on a site, including physical devices (computers, smartphones) and active VPN connections.

requests.name: Get Connected Client Details
requests.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific connected client, including name, IP address, MAC address, connection type and access information.

requests.name: Execute Client Action
requests.description: Perform an action on a specific connected client. The request body must include the action name and any applicable input arguments.

requests.name: List Networks
requests.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all Networks on a site.

requests.name: Create Network
requests.description: Create a new network on a site.

requests.name: Delete Network
requests.description: Delete an existing network on a site.

requests.name: Get Network Details
requests.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific network.

requests.name: Update Network
requests.description: Update an existing network on a site.

requests.name: Get Network References
requests.description: Retrieve references to a specific network.

requests.name: List Wifi Broadcasts

requests.name: Create Wifi Broadcast

requests.name: Delete Wifi Broadcast
requests.description: Delete an existing Wifi Broadcast from the specified site.

requests.name: Get Wifi Broadcast Details
requests.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Wifi.

requests.name: Update Wifi Broadcast
requests.description: Update an existing Wifi Broadcast on the specified site.
